faultHypotheses.rationale: The controller manual states temperature alarm is enabled when temperature exceeds setpoint-based thresholds, and the incident was triggered by a telemetry rule with a high-temperature fault family hypothesis.

The manual says probe alarms start after a related probe fault and stop after normal operation resumes; the controller also has fault-probe timing behavior, so a probe issue remains plausible without telemetry details.

body.summary: Evidence is limited to an operator-attested XR60CX manual and the asset snapshot. The manual supports that high-temperature alarms are possible and that probe faults can affect control behavior, but no telemetry details, setpoint values, wiring status, or actual incident measurements were provided. No replacement part is supported; recommend diagnostic review rather than any compatibility or corrective approval.
